objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a young adult patient presenting with altered mental status, suspected of having a serious drug reaction.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Yesterday in the heat I became very sleepy and unresponsive, and I’ve been told I was acting oddly outdoors. Since then I’ve had a very high fever, a fast heartbeat and high blood pressure, with dry mouth and stiff muscles.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you often find yourself needing to urinate suddenly, or feeling like you have to go right away?
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t noticed any sudden urges to urinate or feeling like I have to go right away.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any firm or hard areas in your breast tissue, perhaps a lump that feels distinct from the rest of your breast?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any breast lumps or firm areas on my chest. I’ve mainly been very sleepy and hard to respond to, with a very high fever and stiff muscles since that episode.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, firm bumps on your skin that are smooth to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any small, firm bumps on my skin. I’ve mainly been very sleepy and hard to respond to, with a very high fever, dry mouth, and stiff muscles.”

turns.doctor_question: I've been reviewing your symptoms, and I want to ask: Have you been having trouble cooling down or feeling like your body temperature is staying too high, even when you're in a cool environment or not exerting yourself?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes—my temperature has stayed very high despite not doing anything, and I can’t seem to cool down. I’ve also had a very fast heartbeat, high blood pressure, dry mouth, and stiff muscles, and I’ve been hard to stay awake or respond.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or anxiety in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t really feel anxiety or stress—I just can’t stay awake or respond. Even in a cooler environment my body feels like it won’t cool down, with a very high fever, fast heartbeat, dry mouth, and stiff muscles.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching sensations on your skin lately, either all over or in specific areas?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any itching sensations—my main issues are that I can’t stay awake or respond, and I’ve had a very high fever that won’t go down, with a fast heartbeat, high blood pressure, dry mouth, and stiff muscles.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions or unusual marks along the veins on your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any unusual skin marks or lesions along the veins on my arms. I’ve mostly just been extremely sleepy and unresponsive, with a very high fever that won’t go down, fast heartbeat, high blood pressure, dry mouth, and stiff muscles.”

turns.doctor_question: you noticed that it's been harder to find the right words when you're trying to say something lately? For example, do you sometimes struggle to think of a specific word that's on the tip of your tongue?

turns.doctor_question: How are you feeling today in terms of your level of alertness? Are you feeling unusually sleepy or drowsy?
turns.patient_answer: “I’m still very sleepy and hard to respond to—I can’t stay awake. My fever feels extremely high and I don’t seem to cool down, and my muscles feel stiff.”
